The snapshot also reports 162141293460093467 circulating ZYS atoms and yield_price 1985186500000 atoms. The pinned protocol source calculates the yield price by dividing the ZSD yield reserve by circulating ZYS and truncating the result; this review does not assert exact reserve-to-liability reconciliation or independent explorer corroboration. Underlying ZSD collateral and its unresolved factors stay upstream.
